title: AG-JEPA: Anatomically Guided Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Neurodegenerative Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Brain MRI can reveal early signs of Alzheimers disease (AD) before measurable cognitive decline becomes apparent. However, during the transition from cognitively normal (CN) to mild cognitive impairment (MCI), the disease-related signals are often subtle and confined to only a few brain regions. Existing Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models learn general structural representations but do not explicitly capture the anatomical regions affected in AD. We propose Anatomically Guided JEPA (AG-JEPA), which introduces anatomical tokens that interact with patch tokens during pretraining to learn region-specific representations from brain regions relevant to neurodegeneration. Building on this representation space, we further propose Prog-AG-JEPA, which models disease progression trajectory as a conditioned latent displacement within this space. translated_title: AG-JEPA：用于神经退行性疾病表征学习的解剖学引导联合嵌入预测架构
translated_abstract: 脑部MRI可以在可测量的认知衰退变得明显之前揭示阿尔茨海默病（AD）的早期迹象。然而，在从认知正常（CN）向轻度认知障碍（MCI）过渡的阶段，疾病相关信号往往十分微弱，且仅局限于少数脑区。现有的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）模型学习的是一般性的结构表征，但并未显式捕获AD所涉及的解剖区域。我们提出了解剖学引导的JEPA（AG-JEPA），它在预训练过程中引入与图像块token进行交互的解剖学token，以从与神经退行性变相关的脑区中学习区域特定的表征。在这一表征空间的基础上，我们进一步提出了Prog-AG-JEPA，它将疾病进展轨迹建模为该空间内的条件化潜在位移。我们在涵盖阿尔茨海默病诊断的五个下游任务上对AG-JEPA进行了评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AG-JEPA，通过在JEPA预训练中引入与图像块token交互的解剖学token来学习AD相关脑区的区域特定表征，并进一步提出Prog-AG-JEPA将疾病进展轨迹建模为表征空间中的条件化潜在位移。
en_tdlr: AG-JEPA introduces anatomical tokens that interact with patch tokens during JEPA pretraining to learn region-specific representations of AD-affected brain areas, and Prog-AG-JEPA further models disease progression as a conditioned latent displacement within this anatomically guided representation space.
